turns.replyText:
Hi Lina,

We want you to shop with confidence, so we offer easy refunds and store credits within 14 days of receiving your order. To be eligible for a return, please make sure your items meet the following requirements:

Unworn and in their original condition with all tags attached
Returns ribbons secured where applicable
Free from any marks or stains such as makeup or spray tans
Hygiene stickers still in place for bodysuits, swimwear, and undergarments
Please note that earrings and underwear accessories cannot be returned due to hygiene reasons

You can easily process your return through our Returns Portal.

Hope you have a great day! Let me know if you need anything else. ✨

turns.q: How many days do I have to return something?
turns.replyTail: Lina, you have 14 days from receiving your order to return items for a refund, and up to 21 days if you are returning them for store credit.

turns.q: How do I start a return or an exchange?
turns.replyTail:
Lina, you can start your return by visiting our online Returns Portal. Simply enter your details there to book your items.

Please note that we do not offer direct exchanges. Instead, you can select store credit during the return process, which will be sent to your email as a gift card so you can easily place a new order for the correct size or style.
